purpose: Training-only complete-mixture public-global history diagnostic after correcting minibatch loss normalization. Frozen behavior policy; whole games and zero resets; no candidate promotion.
loss: Absolute error with unchanged episode/reached-phase weights
epoch_selection: Fixed final epoch; no tuning to held-out training-fold labels.
evaluation: All out-of-fold phase representative predictions retained. Report pooled and per-fold/phase/seat/style gains, training fit and correction magnitude. Do not choose a model from an aggregate concealing late regressions.
decision_rule: Inspect both seeds, all family folds, full-phase and representative errors. The historical screen pass flag is insufficient; require positive learning at all phases under both measurements before considering a candidate. Final acceptance and WDL calibration remain separate.
comparability: Same fold and evaluation samples as the static screen. Different sequence optimizer batching and learning rate; this is not a compute-matched architecture comparison.
comparison: Compare with the existing static public-global complete-mixture results. Different optimizer batch units and learning rate mean this is not a compute-matched causal architecture comparison.
